summary: Iteration 34 - Testing 7 new features for GymFix AI. All backend APIs pass (15/15 tests). Frontend features verified: Steps Already Taken field in fault form, PO Defaults settings with Gym Details and Standard Prices, Supplier Communication email button, auto-sync to Sicon (no manual button), and structured triage display with cards. Fixed a bug where ai_triage JSON was not being parsed into ai_triage_parsed for structured display.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed bug: ai_triage JSON string was not being parsed into ai_triage_parsed object for structured display in IssueDetailPanel
Steps Already Taken field (data-testid='issue-steps-taken-input') is visible in Log a Fault dialog with helper text
PO Defaults section in Settings shows Gym Details card (address, contact, phone, email) and Standard Prices card (callout fee, labour rate, mileage rate, parts markup)
Custom Default Line Items area with Add Custom Item button is functional
Supplier Communication section with Request Info email button is visible in IssueDetailPanel
No manual 'Sync to Sicon' button - auto-sync on submit is working
Structured triage display shows: MEDIUM/LOW/CRITICAL severity badge, Can Fix On-Site/Needs Engineer badge, DIAGNOSIS card, APPLIED FIX card (when fix selected)
seed_data_creation: Created test issues (TEST-FIX-001, TEST-COMM-001, TEST-SN-002) and PO defaults during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 34 features verified: 1) Steps Already Taken field in fault form feeds into AI triage prompt. 2) Supplier Communication email button (POST /api/issues/{id}/request-info) sends email to gym. 3) No manual Sicon sync button - auto-sync on submit. 4) Structured triage display with cards (Diagnosis, Applied Fix, severity/can-fix badges). 5) PO Defaults in Settings (GET/PUT /api/settings/po-defaults, GET/PUT /api/settings/org-details). 6) Gym details auto-populate in PO delivery address. Bug fixed: ai_triage JSON parsing for structured display.
